assets.name: pale_stone
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless square diffuse albedo texture for pale warm limestone masonry in a fine voxel Mediterranean waterfront game. Orthographic flat 2D texture fills the ENTIRE square, no frame or margin. Four horizontal courses of long rectangular limestone blocks with staggered joints, moderate broad irregular mineral colour, very thin shallow warm-grey mortar seams. Low saturation ivory sand beige, clean crafted coastal building, readable large forms when reduced to 64x64 pixels. Treat it as an unlit base colour map: even ambient lighting, NO cast shadow, no bevel lighting, no highlight, no vignette, no perspective, no object or scene, no text or watermark. Seamless tile repeats at left/right and top/bottom. Calm restrained surface, not noisy photoreal speckles, no crack grids, no black outlines. One single texture only, no collage or contact sheet. Square high-quality source.

assets.name: rough_stone
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single seamless square diffuse albedo texture for a refined editable voxel Mediterranean waterfront game. Texture: coarse warm-grey natural limestone rubble masonry. Five to seven irregular horizontally elongated pale grey tan stones, narrow flat mortar seams, varied quiet grain; tactile but low contrast. Small irregular stones arranged as repeating square tile.
